description: Drafts a Brazilian payment receipt, rent receipt, service quote or service order on Reciba from the details in the conversation and returns a single-use link where the person reviews the full preview and issues it from their own Reciba account. This tool issues, charges and sends nothing. It is for documents the person issues about their own service, sale or rental. It is not for a tax invoice (nota fiscal), for a receipt that someone else has to issue (for example a dentist's or a landlord's receipt for the person), for health-service receipts that professionals issue in Receita Saúde, or for advice on prices, such as how much to charge. CPF, CNPJ and RG numbers are not accepted; the person adds them on the site if needed. Amounts in reais as "1500,00"; dates as YYYY-MM-DD; months as YYYY-MM; item lists as arrays of objects with the columns of the type.
